target_customer: Healthcare companies wanting to offer prescription medical devices to patients, and consumers needing sleep apnea diagnosis through its Helio Sleep brand
problem: Home medical equipment lacks an end to end stack for inventory, logistics, clinical support and device data. Sleep apnea is undiagnosed in roughly 24 million Americans (YC launch post claim).
business_model: B2B2C healthcare logistics and clinical platform plus cash pay consumer sleep apnea testing and devices (Helio Sleep)
product_category: Home medical equipment and sleep apnea telehealth

founders.name: Rebecca Weisinger
founders.background_notes: YC page lists a chemistry degree from Harvard. The launch post says the team worked at Counsyl, Truepill, Medallion and Q Bio without saying who worked where.

founders.name: Max Greenfeld
founders.background_notes: YC page: early employee leading data and engineering projects at Q Bio and Genapsys.

competitors.name: Lofta
competitors.what: Sells CPAP machines and sleep apnea testing online

technical_complexity.rationale: Logistics, telehealth workflow and integration of third party test devices (Ectosense, Itamar per one profile); mostly operations rather than novel technology.

defensibility.rationale: Relies on commodity devices and provider networks; one profile notes it did not take Medicare accreditation, which limits payer coverage.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No acquisition or copying found. A 2026 aggregator lists the company as out of business (unverified).

market_need_then: YC launch post cites about 24 million undiagnosed sleep apnea patients in the US and growth in home delivered care in 2021.

branding.domain_note: Company site equipthealth.com; consumer brand site heliosleep.com

identity.voice_and_tone: Plain and consumer friendly: 'Home medical equipment, prescribed online and delivered'

branding.brand_signature: Helio Sleep consumer brand, launched on Product Hunt on March 3, 2022
branding.community_and_virality: Product Hunt launch for Helio Sleep in March 2022; no merch or fan community found.

brand_strength.rationale: Equipt Health is easily confused with the larger Equip Health (eating disorder care) in search results, and Helio Sleep had little coverage.

pivots.from: B2B home medical equipment platform for healthcare companies
pivots.to: Also consumer sleep apnea testing and treatment under Helio Sleep
pivots.why: YC page says the company starts with sleep apnea through heliosleep.com; reason not otherwise stated

outcome_analysis: Equipt Health targeted home delivered medical devices, starting with sleep apnea through Helio Sleep, a consumer cash pay offering launched in March 2022. No credible funding round was found beyond a $500K convertible note listed by CB Insights, and a 2026 aggregator lists it as out of business, so the outcome and cause are not public.
notes: Company website returned HTTP 503 when fetched. CB Insights lists a $500K convertible note with Y Combinator (single aggregator, unverified, not recorded as a round). Healthcare Discovery cites PitchBook listing deal type Out of Business dated Dec 2025; YC directory status is Active, so exit type is unknown. The launch post does not name rivals; Lofta comes from a March 2022 Hacker News comment quoted by a profile, several months after the batch. Failure cause not public. Funding search results largely referred to a different company called Equip Health. Completeness pass: the $500K convertible note is recorded as a round (stage other, date not given) but rests on a single database (CB Insights, page returned 403 when fetched).
